shortDescription: Create, update, or delete L7 load balancer instances via Servers.com Public API

options.name: cluster_id
options.description: Unique identifier of a dedicated load balancer cluster.

options.name: delete_external_ips
options.description: List of external IP addresses to delete (update only).

options.name: endpoint
options.description: Endpoint to use to connect to API. Do not change until specifically asked to do otherwise. If not set, the value of the C(SERVERSCOM_API_URL) environment variable is used.

options.name: id
options.description: Unique identifier of the balancer (required for update and deletion).

options.name: labels
options.description: Dictionary of labels to attach to the resource.

options.name: location_id
options.description: Location ID where the balancer will be created.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the balancer (required for creation if id is not provided).

options.name: new_external_ips_count
options.description: Number of new external IP addresses to assign (update only).

options.name: shared_cluster
options.description: Whether to use a shared cluster for the balancer. When true, the balancer will be moved to a shared cluster.

options.name: state
options.description: Desired state of the L7 instance.

options.name: store_logs_region_id
options.description: Cloud region ID for logs storage.

options.name: token
options.description: Token to use. You can create token for your account in https://portal.servers.com in Profile -> Public API section. If not set, the value of the C(SERVERSCOM_API_TOKEN) or C(SC_TOKEN) environment variable is used (C(SERVERSCOM_API_TOKEN) takes precedence). Value is not logged.

options.name: update_interval
options.description: Interval in seconds between status checks.

options.name: upstream_zones
options.description: List of upstream zones (groups of upstream servers with predefined parameters).

options.name: wait
options.description: Timeout in seconds to wait for the operation to complete.
